verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-filing features: dashboards to track formalities, an overview of submitted filings, and a payment method suited to agents who file many formalities. None of this documents acting on many items at once, such as batch submission, bulk edits or mass uploads. A tracking dashboard and a high-volume payment option are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
